title: Run the project packs nerv calls over MCP (grover-v1, fpvbuddy-v1, hobo-v1)
goal: NERV's models are measured on the tools of other projects
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposal from solution:F-016, docs/reviews/2026-11-shared-assets/gauntlet-nerv.md); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".
nerv's campaign takes grover-v1, fpvbuddy-v1 and hobo-v1 from each project's tagged release and records them in the ledger like its own packs; a project pack without a tag is refused
The packs include Italian phrasings (owner 2026-11-26); a pack without them is reported, not run silently
Depends on grover:F-027 (grover-v1), fpvbuddy:F-022 (fpvbuddy-v1) and hobo:F-011-T03 (hobo-v1) releases; covers F-123, F-131, F-101
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: The first model run and any --allow-models run need the owner (human action); a material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: From solution:F-016-T03 proposal 3; Italian phrasings are part of every case set (owner 2026-11-26): each capability has Italian and English requests. Not a measurement.
